Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's own heading for 23. јануар ст. ст. (civil 2026-02-05), „Свети Павлин Милостиви“. The word „Свети“ is left off; „Милостиви“ — the Merciful — is kept, being the epithet the folder's own display name carries and not a rank.

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru's life of him: «Скончался 78 лет 22 июня 431 года»; the day line prints the year as (431). The page gives his age at death but no year of birth, and none is worked out here.
